scope: Two machines, one role, one log group with only its own RESOURCE-scoped policy, one default-bus rule and queue, eight short Pass/Fail/Wait executions. No account-scoped policy, trail, Lake, or existing-resource mutation.
serialization: Boto3 response dictionaries retained including ResponseMetadata; datetime objects serialized as ISO-8601 strings. SQS receipt handles and temporary STS credentials are redacted. CloudTrail LookupEvents responses retain only prefix-correlated Events, unchanged, and report excluded counts.

claims: Delivery is best effort.
ALL logs every type; ERROR includes FailStateEntered and ExecutionFailed/TimedOut/Aborted; FATAL excludes FailStateEntered; OFF logs none.
Express GetExecutionHistory is unavailable.
Only Standard workflows emit status events; best effort and potentially out of order.
Envelope source aws.states and detail-type Step Functions Execution Status Change.
AWS/States with StateMachineArn dimensions; delivery best effort.
ExecutionsStarted emits 1 then 0 on completion, hence SampleCount 2 and Sum 1 per execution.
StartExecution and control/read APIs are management events.
Current documentation explicitly lists StartSyncExecution and InvokeHTTPEndpoint as data events for AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine.
Event history does not record data events. This supersedes older SDK language claiming StartSyncExecution is entirely unlogged.
Read current page: no globally-unlogged note; synchronous failure returns HTTP 200 with FAILED status.
A resourceArn policy applies only to that LogGroup.

sources.role: Shared native transport used for caller and resource-policy preflight.

claims: LookupEvents returns management or Insights events, not data events.
Immediate starts after updates may use previous definition/role. Native capture shows stale Express definition/logging despite current DescribeStateMachine configuration.
New log deliveries use log-group resource policies; existing policies must not be modified by this probe.
Default policyScope is ACCOUNT; RESOURCE plus resourceArn is required to enumerate the owned group policy. Cleanup verified both separately.

setup_attempts.scope: Two machines, one role, one log group with only its own RESOURCE-scoped policy, one default-bus rule and queue, eight short Pass/Fail/Wait executions. No account-scoped policy, trail, Lake, or existing-resource mutation.
setup_attempts.serialization: Boto3 response dictionaries retained including ResponseMetadata; datetime objects serialized as ISO-8601 strings. SQS receipt handles and temporary STS credentials are redacted. CloudTrail LookupEvents responses retain only prefix-correlated Events, unchanged, and report excluded counts.

claims: Delivery is best effort.
ALL logs every type; ERROR includes FailStateEntered and ExecutionFailed/TimedOut/Aborted; FATAL excludes FailStateEntered; OFF logs none.
Express GetExecutionHistory is unavailable.
Only Standard workflows emit status events; best effort and potentially out of order.
Envelope source aws.states and detail-type Step Functions Execution Status Change.
AWS/States with StateMachineArn dimensions; delivery best effort.
ExecutionsStarted emits 1 then 0 on completion, hence SampleCount 2 and Sum 1 per execution.
StartExecution and control/read APIs are management events.
Current documentation explicitly lists StartSyncExecution and InvokeHTTPEndpoint as data events for AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine.
Event history does not record data events. This supersedes older SDK language claiming StartSyncExecution is entirely unlogged.
Read current page: no globally-unlogged note; synchronous failure returns HTTP 200 with FAILED status.
A resourceArn policy applies only to that LogGroup.

sources.role: Shared native transport used for caller and resource-policy preflight.

Error.Message: Both policy name and resource arn cannot be specified at the same time.

observation_window.definition: One wall-clock window from the first execution start; no log/metric polling after its deadline.

eventbridge.delivery: Native best effort; collection order is not a guaranteed emission order; do not infer completeness from this sample.
timing_and_payload_rules_observed: Envelope version=0 string; source=aws.states; detail-type=Step Functions Execution Status Change; resources contains execution ARN.
Envelope time is UTC second-resolution text; detail.startDate/stopDate are numeric epoch milliseconds, stopDate null while RUNNING.
Input/output are escaped JSON strings, not nested objects. inputDetails.included=true even for machines configured to exclude CloudWatch Logs execution data.
Succeeded output/outputDetails are populated; non-success output/outputDetails null. Failed and aborted error/cause retain supplied values; timeout error/cause null in this sample.
FAILED/ABORTED/TIMED_OUT had redriveStatus=REDRIVABLE with redriveStatusReason=null; RUNNING and SUCCEEDED had NOT_REDRIVABLE plus reason text.
ABORTED and TIMED_OUT were collected before their corresponding RUNNING events; delivery order is not execution order.

cloudwatch_logs.delivery: Native best effort. OFF and level-filter absences are bounded observations plus the documented logging-level contract, not a global delivery guarantee.

non_history_delivery_validation_messages.example: Permissions are set correctly to allow AWS CloudWatch Logs to write into your logs while creating a subscription.
non_history_delivery_validation_messages.interpretation: Native log-delivery subscription validation messages, not Step Functions history events; retained unchanged in raw evidence.

timing.event_timestamp: Epoch milliseconds encoded as a JSON string
timing.cloudwatch_timestamp_and_ingestionTime: Epoch milliseconds encoded as JSON numbers
timing.limitation: Observed delays only, not a service guarantee; first_observed_at includes polling delay.

payload_rules_observed: Log message JSON uses details, execution_arn, type, and string-valued id/previous_event_id/redrive_count/event_timestamp.
ALL,true includes escaped JSON input/output and inputDetails/outputDetails.truncated=false.
ALL,false omits input/output and their Details fields while retaining details.name or details.roleArn; ExecutionSucceeded has empty details.
ERROR,false Standard failure emits FailStateEntered without input and ExecutionFailed retaining error/cause.
FATAL,false Standard timeout emits only ExecutionTimedOut; no input/output.
OFF Express failure produced no correlated execution history log in this window; native subscription-validation messages still exist in the log group.

Standard success was first collected as ExecutionSucceeded before its earlier ExecutionStarted/Wait/Pass records arrived; sort by execution and history id for history presentation, not collection order.

cloudtrail.scope: LookupEvents management-event projections only. StartSyncExecution data-event audit is outside LookupEvents; no trail/data selector/Lake was created.
projection_rules_observed: CreateStateMachine/UpdateStateMachine definition, StartExecution input, and StopExecution error/cause are HIDDEN_DUE_TO_SECURITY_REASONS in native CloudTrail requestParameters.
Create/Update records include loggingConfiguration; responses retain state-machine ARN/dates/revisionId as applicable.
Read API records have readOnly=true and responseElements=null. Exact identities/request IDs/TLS metadata and service-native redactions are preserved.

cloudwatch_metrics_notes: Final AWS/States queries with only the StateMachineArn dimension returned count/time metrics for both workflow types.
All five Executions* count metrics had SampleCount=8 for four executions per machine, including zero-sum statuses; do not count executions using SampleCount.
Standard sums: started=4,succeeded=1,failed=1,aborted=1,timedout=1. Express sums: started=4,succeeded=3,failed=1,aborted=0,timedout=0. The stale-revision Express case really succeeded.

ExecutionTime is Milliseconds with SampleCount=4 per machine. ExpressExecutionBilledDuration uses Milliseconds; ExpressExecutionBilledMemory and ExpressExecutionMemory use Bytes in these source emissions.
Counts/sums are observed aggregates, not exactly-once guarantees. Query datapoint order is retained unchanged in raw observations.

stepfunctions_history.note: Express DescribeExecution and GetExecutionHistory returned InvalidArn for the native express ARN; this is the observed rejection, not an invented StateMachineTypeNotSupported error.

limitations.detail: Only 7 envelopes were received. RUNNING for standard-all-data-pass was not seen within the 282.933-second observation window; other Standard RUNNING events were positively observed. No claim that successful Standard executions lack RUNNING.
No Express status envelopes observed for four synchronous executions; primary docs explicitly restrict native status events to Standard. Asynchronous Express starts were not exercised.
No history records for terminal express-off-data-fail during this bounded window; OFF is documented to suppress all execution event types. Delivery remains best effort.

Requested Fail/ERROR,true was visible through DescribeStateMachine after ten seconds but immediate StartSyncExecution selected the older Pass/ALL,false behavior. This case is not evidence for Express ERROR filtering. Eight-execution cap was respected, with no replacement execution.

StartSyncExecution is listed as a data event in current primary documentation and is outside LookupEvents management history. No data selector, trail, or Lake was created, so native data-event emission was not measured. Do not interpret its absence here as globally unsupported CloudTrail audit.

32 correlated records covering seven operation types were returned. Lookup latency, four-page cap per sample, and the bounded observation window prevent a completeness claim; cleanup deletion calls occurred after audit collection.
Small payloads only: truncation/large payload boundaries, version/alias metrics, redrive events, asynchronous Express executions, and account-level aggregates were not probed.

adapter_observations.schema_scope: Field-shape maps describe observed native samples, not exhaustive schemas or required-field declarations. Raw responses remain authoritative.
